analysis.title: Leonardo DRS (DRS): Quietly outperforming within defense tech; Buy
key_insights: GS reiterates Buy on Leonardo DRS after 3Q26 results, with a 12-month price target of $55 (up from $53) against a $37.68 price, implying 46.0% upside.
3Q26 revenue of $1,066mn grew 11% y/y and was 4% above FactSet consensus. Total EBITDA of $149mn was 7% above consensus, on a 14.0% margin, up 180bps y/y.

GS argues DRS keeps delivering double-digit organic revenue growth, new business wins, margin expansion and free cash conversion, yet remains relatively off the radar within defense tech, which GS says creates an attractive valuation.

Advanced Sensing and Computing (ASC) revenue was $659mn, up 14% y/y, driven by demand for tactical radars and space sensing programs. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 11.8%, up 80bps y/y on execution, program mix and volume.
Integrated Mission Systems (IMS) revenue was $428mn, up 12% y/y, driven by naval power and propulsion programs. Adjusted EBITDA margin was 16.6%, up 280bps y/y on volume and execution.
Company-reported book-to-bill was 1.5X (ASC 1.54X, IMS 1.45X). Funded backlog was $5,640mn, up 21% y/y.
3Q26 free cash flow was $61mn versus $77mn a year earlier. Cash and equivalents ended the quarter at $294mn ($1.10/share).
3Q26 diluted EPS of $0.46 compared with the GS estimate of $0.35 and $0.29 in 3Q25. The effective tax rate was 3.1% versus 17.2% in the GS estimate, which accounts for much of the EPS gap.

The company raised 2026 guidance: revenue $3,950-3,985mn (prior $3,900-3,975mn, consensus $3,950mn), adjusted EBITDA $545-555mn (prior $525-540mn, consensus $537mn), adjusted EPS $1.50-$1.53 (prior $1.34-$1.39, consensus $1.39).
GS raised 2026-2030E adjusted EBITDA to $550/610/682/753/820mn from $538/590/635/687/736mn, reflecting updated segment revenue and margins.
GS now forecasts EPS of $1.51 for 2026E (old $1.40), $1.54 for 2027E (old $1.48) and $1.73 for 2028E (old $1.59). Revenue forecasts are $3,981mn, $4,329mn and $4,675mn for 2026E-2028E.
The price target of $55 rests on a target 23.5X 2027E EV/EBITDA, unchanged. DRS trades at 24.9X 2026E P/E and 17.7X 2026E EV/EBITDA.
The stock is down 17.4% over 3 months and 7.3% over 6 months in absolute terms, and 19.0% and 11.8% relative to the S&P 500 over the same periods.
Key risks named by GS: Columbia class execution, more difficult terms with customers, and DoD shifting priorities away from DRS products.

market_movers.rationale: GS reiterates Buy after a 3Q26 beat on revenue, EBITDA and EPS and a guidance raise, and lifts the price target to $55 from $53. GS says the stock is relatively off the radar within defense tech, which leaves valuation attractive.

earnings_insights: DRS 3Q26 (reported, adjusted): revenue $1,066mn vs FactSet consensus about 4% lower and GS estimate $1,016mn; +11.0% y/y from $960mn.
DRS 3Q26 (reported, adjusted): total EBITDA $149mn vs GS estimate $136mn (+9.3%), 7% above FactSet consensus; margin 14.0% vs GS estimate 13.4% and 12.2% in 3Q25.
DRS 3Q26 (reported): diluted EPS $0.46 vs GS estimate $0.35 and $0.29 in 3Q25, with an effective tax rate of 3.1% vs 17.2% in the GS estimate. GS also states EPS was ahead of FactSet consensus.

DRS 2026 guidance (company, updated): revenue $3,950-3,985mn (prior $3,900-3,975mn; FactSet consensus $3,950mn), adj. EBITDA $545-555mn (prior $525-540mn; consensus $537mn), adj. EPS $1.50-$1.53 (prior $1.34-$1.39; consensus $1.39).
GS forecasts (estimate): 2026E-2028E revenue growth of 9.1%, 8.7% and 8.0%, EBITDA growth of 24.1%, 10.9% and 11.9%, and EBIT margin of 11.0%, 11.4% and 11.9%.
GS forecasts (estimate) free cash flow of $285mn in 2026E, $306mn in 2027E and $345mn in 2028E, versus $227mn in 2025.
